urgency.reason: Urgency language detected — scammers use time pressure to prevent you from thinking clearly
urgency.advice: Take your time. Legitimate organizations never demand immediate action via SMS/email.

account_threat.reason: Account threat detected — threatening to block/suspend your account to scare you
account_threat.advice: Call your bank/service directly using the official number on their website.

verification_request.reason: Verification request detected — asking you to "verify" personal information
verification_request.advice: Never verify personal details through links in SMS/email. Use official apps/websites.

otp_request.reason: OTP/Password request detected — NO legitimate service asks you to share your OTP
otp_request.advice: NEVER share OTP with anyone. Banks/UPI apps will NEVER ask for your OTP.

prize_lottery.reason: Prize/Lottery scam detected — you cannot win a contest you never entered
prize_lottery.advice: Ignore completely. Report to cybercrime.gov.in if you get such messages.

financial_lure.reason: Financial lure detected — offering money/prizes to lower your guard
financial_lure.advice: If it sounds too good to be true, it is. Verify through official channels only.

suspicious_url.reason: Suspicious link detected — contains URL that may lead to a fake website
suspicious_url.advice: Do NOT click links in SMS/email. Type the official website address manually.

personal_info_request.reason: Personal information request detected — asking for sensitive data
personal_info_request.advice: Never share card numbers, CVV, Aadhaar, or PAN through SMS/email/phone.

upi_fraud.reason: UPI/Payment fraud pattern detected — targeting digital payment systems
upi_fraud.advice: Never share UPI PIN. Use only official bank apps. Enable transaction limits.

impersonation.reason: Brand/Authority impersonation detected — pretending to be a trusted organization
impersonation.advice: Contact the organization directly using their official website/app to verify.
